    The Hamming distance is the number of differing items in ordered sequences.

    https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hamming_distance

        self.test_func = test_func or self._ident
        self.truncate = truncate
        self.external = external

    def __call__(self, *sequences: Sequence[object]) -> int:

        _zip = zip if self.truncate else zip_longest

This would cause unpredictable behavior in any code that uses `enumerate`, including the Needleman-Wunsch and Smith-Waterman algorithms which rely on proper sequence indexing.
